batting.name: B Sai Sudharsan
batting.dismissal: c N Pooran b Ravi Bishnoi

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b Avesh Khan

batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c SN Thakur b DS Rathi

batting.name: R Tewatia
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b SN Thakur

batting.name: AK Markram
batting.dismissal: c Shubman Gill b M Prasidh Krishna

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c Washington Sundar b M Prasidh Krishna

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c M Shahrukh Khan b Rashid Khan

balls.text: Full around off, Rashid squeezes it out towards deep midwicket and they manage to run two to finish on 180
Ooooh, that's just cleared mid-off running back! Short outside off, Rashid backs away and slaps it in front. Just about clears Markram!

Shardul strikes again with another full toss! He is on a hat-trick! Low full toss outside off and Tewatia moves across to try and heave it down the ground. No timinng on that, it goes high in the air and Markram isn't dropping those at long-on! They have a check for the height on the full toss, but the umpire's check confirms it was a fair delivery

Up goes the finger! Shardul Thakur took two wickets with full tosses against KKR, and he has got one here today! Rutherford moves across a long way, expecting the wide yorker. But Shardul goes full on the stumps. He misses his length but Rutherford misses his flick and is struck in front. Umpire had no hesitation in giving that out
Now Shardul digs it into the pitch with pace off, Shahrukh waits and looks to pull but it goes high in the air. Lands safely in front of deep midwicket
Low full toss from Shardul going down leg. Shahrukh backs away to stay inside the line and he swings this away behind square Flat six, well placed too!
Full outside off, Shahrukh swings it down towards long-on
Avesh nails the yorker on the stumps, Rutherford manages to keep it out. That was 138kph
Full outside off, squeezed out to sweeper cover
Full on leg, Rutherford looks for a big heave and only gets an inside edge to the keeper's right. They scamper for a run
Back to back boundaries! Full around leg, Rutherford backs away a long way and jams his bat down with an open face and steers it fine of short third
Too full on leg and Rutherford swings it away along the ground, fine on the leg side. In the gap and that's four more for Rutherford
Rutherford goes across the stumps as Shardul goes for a wide yorker again. Drives it out to long-off
This attempted yorker outside off turns into a juicy full toss and Rutherford finally picks up a boundary as he flicks this square

Another wide yorker, this time nailed to perfection. Rutherford looks to squeeze it out but can't get it away. Rutherford reviews for a wide. The replay shows the ball just kissing the adjusted wide line as Rutherford had moved across. Pooran, meanwhile is flat on his stomach and relaxing, and stretching a bit now as we wait. The third umpire adjudicates it to be a wide in the end as no part of the ball was inside the wide line
Back of length delivery, Shardul takes the pace off and Shahrukh has to wait a long while on that before helping it behind square for a single. Pretty good over from Shardul so far!
Length ball slides down leg. He'll have to bowl that again. Remember, Shardul bowled five consecutive wides in his last match!
Misses the length on this wide yorker, turns into a full toss, and Rutherford can only steer it out to deep point
Goes for a wide yorker again and Rutherford goes across to try and scoop it away, but he misses and it hits the outstretched right foot and through to Pant
Shardul goes for another wide yorker, but this time misses his line by a bit
Goes for a wide yorker, Rutherford opens his face to push it out to point
It's a short wrong'un again, Rutherford looks to swat it away again but miscues his pull. It goes to deep midwicket on the bounce
Full around off, angling into him, Shahrukh clips it square on the leg side for a single

Shardul Thakur takes a blinder and out comes Rathi's notebook on the ground! Buttler looks to sweep conventionally this time as Rathi bowls the carrom ball. Top edges it and Shardul at short leg has to run a way to his left but he grabs it on the dive and holds on. Had his shades on and everything. Cool as you like it, Shardul!
Buttler nails the reverse-sweep! Googly outside off and Buttler hammers it behind point

There is the big hit and Pant has shelled it! Googly dropped short on leg and Rutherford makes a meal of it with his attempted pull. Skies it off the toe end and it goes high in the sky to Pant's right. He gets under it, taking his cap off, claiming it, but just misses it as he dives forward to take it
Googly on a length outside off, Buttler backs away and cuts it out hard to point
A quick one on a length on off, and it zips past Rutherford's attempted cut. Only four off that over!
Tossed full outside off, Buttler drives it down to long-off
Wrong'un on a length on off, going away from Rutherford, but he is able to cut it away to point
Darted in on a length on off at 101kph, Buttler flicks it through midwicket and picks up a brace
Tossed full on leg, Rutherford eases it down to long-on

Big shout for lbw as Rutherford takes on a full ball around middle with a big slog sweep and misses it completely. Hit on the pads in front of off. But they don't bother with a review. That was likely sliding across
On a length on the stumps again, Rutherford drops it towards point and they squeeze a single
On a length on leg, Rutherford steers it to point
Short outside off, Buttler looks for the pull and gets an inside edge through fine leg
Avesh goes too full and straight, on middle, Buttler goes across the stumps and just glances it past the keeper down the leg side for a much needed boundary
On a length on leg, Rutherford clips it through square leg

On a length outside off, it seams in off the pitch and Buttler tucks it in front on the leg side for a quick single. The midwicket fielder runs in and has a shy at the stumps at the non-striker's end but misses

Bishnoi gets two in an over! On a length around off and going on straight with the angle. Washington looks to cut but gets a bottom edge onto the stumps! Bishnoi pumps his fists! It's been a tough season for him, but he's making the difference here!
Darts this on a length and across Washington, but it goes too wide
Wrong'un on a length outside off, Buttler waits on it and tucks it to midwicket for a single
Washington goes for the sweep to this full ball outside off but gets it through midwicket off the inside half of the bat

Tossed full outside off, Buttler gets it off the inside half of the bat as he looks to swipe it down the line. The ball deflects towards cover off Washington at the non-striker's end and they get the single
Flighted full on leg, Washington nudges it down the ground to long-on

And Bishnoi strikes! The around the wicket angle works. It's one that skids straight with the angle, Sudharsan is looking to go inside out but can't time this at all. Chips it tamely to Pooran at cover, who takes it above head height
Buttler gives charge to this back of length delivery outside off and is beaten all ends up. The ball flies below bat as he has a swing across the line
On a length outside off, 134kph this time, Buttler tucks it to midwicket
Tucked through square leg for a single. Avesh sticking to his slower balls. This was on a length around leg and angling across the left-hand batter
Full and flicked fine down the leg side to long leg
Length ball outside off, pace off again, Buttler clips it to midwicket

Oh, what a catch! Gill hit that so sweetly and it looked to be headed for the stands. But Aiden Markram is on his toes at long-on and he holds on high above his head and does incredibly well to maintain his balance and not fall over. Took it right on the edge! Avesh Khan bowled this full outside off, tempting Gill to go big, and Gill obliges. But the slower ball does the trick for Avesh
No chance for long-on to save that! This is a slot ball just outside off and Sudharsan smacks it down the ground, quite straight, and it comfortably beats the fielder at the rope

Slower bouncer this time, closer to the batter's body. Sudharsan waits on it and looks to ramp but can't connect. Nice change of pace from Akash Deep. The ramp hasn't worked on the couple of occasions Sudharsan has tried it today
Sai Sudharsan loses his shape as he looks to cut this short ball angled across. Beaten on the outside edge
Low full toss on off, Gill flicks it to deep midwicket's left for a single
Oh, that's as easy as it gets for Gill! Short ball angling down leg and it stays low too. Gill just swipes it away fine on the leg side as it races away. That arrived at hip-height
Back of length ball outside off, doesn't bounce much and Gill slaps it away to sweeper cover

Beautiful placement! Digvesh errs in line, going too full around leg and Sudharsan sweeps it wide of the short fine fielder. Sudharsan brings up his fourth fifty of the season! And he has a 49 as well!
This one comes on with the angle and Gill eases it in front of square leg for a single
Gill comes out of his crease and blocks this length ball
Tucks this length ball square on the leg side

Has that dropped just short? No, that's been dropped at cover! It's a googly on a length outside off, Sudharsan slaps it in front of point and it goes to Samad, who tries to grab it diving forward, but it spills out of his hand
On a length around middle, going on with the angle from around the wicket, Sudharsan looks to tuck it leg side but it goes off his pads
good running! Full and dipping on middle and off, as Gill leans into a clip towards deep midwicket before rushing back for two
another full ball, but this is just outside off. Chipped towards extra cover
another wide! Full and outside leg again, as he looked to whip but misssed
top edge, but Sudharsan is safe! He went slog sweeping at this full ball dipping on middle and off, and played that like a no-look slog. The ball went over the keeper's head, though
wide! Angled in, and it goes on with the angle to land full and outside leg. It finishes wide, as Sudharsan looks to pull but misses
good work by Miller! He was at deep cover, and went running and sliding to his right to keep this to two. Sudharsan cut away at this short and wide-ish ball outside off, as he played late at it
swatted wide of long-off! Short in length, and wide of off, as Sudharsan rides the bounce to dispatch it wide of the man in the deep
on a fullish length, as it dips around middle and off. It is clipped towards deep square, and they pinch two
on a good length on middle and leg, and again turning away to finish around middle and off. Swiped to deep midwicket
full and quicker at 100kph, and just outside off. Punched down to long-off for his fifty
on a fullish length on middle and off, and nudged towards midwicket. The call is for two immediately, and they make it
on a full length on middle and leg, and turning away. Clipped to deep square leg
full ball dipping just outside off, and pushed towards cover for a quick single
on a length on off, and slashed to deep cover after going back in the crease
on a length, and wide-ish of off. A hard late cut to deep-backward point
slower from Markram, who tosses it up and goes full and around sixth stump. Pushed to long-on
down the pitch, and bang! He gets to the pitch of this dipping ball on a full length around sixth stump, and launches it down the ground
On a full length on middle and leg, and clipped to short fine leg
on a length, and dipping around sixth stump. He closes the face of the bat, and nudges towards midwicket
pulled wide of long-on! Short from Markram again, who bowls this outside off this time. But Gill plays powerfully to bisect the fielders at deep midwicket and long-on
starts with a wide! On the shorter side of a length on leg, and turning down to finish wide, as Gill looked to swipe but missed

wow, Pant and Bishnoi are celebrating for caught behind... but the umpire calls it wide! But wait, Pant reviews for a potential wicket! Angled in from Bishnoi, who was bowling from around the wicket, and bowled this on a shortish length around middle and leg. The ball went on with the angle, and replays confirm that while there was no bat involved, there's a spike as the ball tickles Sudharsan's pad after he missed his attempted pull
angled in, and full and outside leg. He looked to clip but missed
pulled between fine leg and deep midwicket! Short in length from Bishnoi, who gets this to finish around off. Sudharsan goes back, and pulls in the gap for four
much fuller in length, but wide of off. Chopped towards point
short in length, and wider of off. The ball turns away, and Gill cuts on the bounce to point
a late cut, and four! Gill shifts his weight back, before slashing this length ball around sixth stump between short third and point
full and flat, and slightly wide of off. Driven hard towards deep extra cover
he sees Gill making room and advancing down, and bowls a slower ball on a short of a length just outside off. Swat-pulled to mid-on for a single
on a good length, and angling across to pitch on middle. Sudharsan pulls to deep-backward square from deep in the crease
slower ball, and on a short of a length in the corridor outside off. Swat-pulled towards deep-backward square leg
on a length, and on his pads again. Flicked to fine leg
a full delivery, and angling across towards middle and off. Tapped towards point, as Avesh bowls it slower
whipped over fine leg! Avesh starts with a good-length ball outside leg, and Sudharsan lifts it late almost off the inside half of the bat for six
short in length again, and on leg. Sudharsan gets slightly across, and pulls to fine leg
another slower ball, but this is quite short and around fifth stump. Pulled to fine leg by Gill, as he rolls his wrists on that
change of pace again, and this time Gill is beaten! On a short of a length, and wide of off. Gill went slashing away from his body but missed, and the ball went on the bounce to Pant
a slower-ball bouncer, and called wide! Akash Deep went short and just outside off, but the ball finished on top of middle, even as Gill hardly had to duck
the ball keeps low, and also comes off slower off the pitch, as Akash Deep goes on a length, and just outside off. Sudharsan clips it towards midwicket, where Miller tumbles to his left to cut it off
short of a length again, and around sixth stump. Pushed just wide of mid-on for a single
flashed through wide mid-off! Short in length from Akash Deep, who gives Gill plenty of width to skip down the pitch and have a free swing of the arms to get four
misfield by Miller at cover point, and that is four! Rathi bowled it very full, and around sixth stump, as Sudharsan jammed his bat at it for a hard drive, which Miller missed
a length ball around off, and punched to long-on
fuller length, and on off. Driven to long-off
angling across the left-hander, as Rathi goes on a length, and just outside off. Cut away on the bounce to point
slightly fuller than the previous ball, but again around middle and off. Clipped towards deep-backward square leg
on a length on middle and off, and Gill nudges it towards wide long-on. There is an early call for two, and the batters make it
angling in, and pitching on a good length on middle and off. Clipped to midwicket for a quick single

sliced between point and short third! It didn't look an entirely convincing shot, even as Gill flashed at this short-of-a-length ball just outside off. Thakur went with the slower ball, and Gill even lost his bottom hand off the bat
on the bounce to extra cover! Again Gill skips down the pitch, and this is a shortish ball wide of off, which he slashes hard, but doesn't find the gap

Thakur goes wide of the crease, and bowls a slower ball on a good length, and wide of off. Gill goes wafting away from his body, but misses. Pant fumbled on the collection, and Gill was sent back by Sudharsan after an attempted bye
a bouncer on middle, and shaping away to finish just outside off. Sudharsan rides the bounce to swat-pull to deep square leg
on the fuller side of a length, and pitching on off or thereabouts. Gill walks down, and punches to long-off, whose presence I just realised
short of a length around fifth stump, and it straightens after being angling in. Dabbed towards cover point to keep going
fullish ball, and angling in to pitch around sixth stump. Blocked by towards Akash Deep by Gill
powerfully punched wide of mid-off! Gill steps out, and thumps at this good-length delivery just outside off. The ball went flying between short extra cover and mid-off
full again, and angling across to pitch on off. Tapped towards point for another quick single
beautifully driven! Sudharsan presents the full face of the bat at this full ball angling across and arriving on off, and drives in the gap between the stumps and Gill

punched aerially towards extra cover! Miller, at cover point, turned around and chased the ball, before pulling the ball back last moment. Akash Deep started with a good-length ball in the channel outside off, as Gill leaned into the shot

ohh, beaten on the attempted ramp! Thakur appeals for caught behind, but it's not given. Pant, though, knows there was nothing. A bouncer from Thakur on middle, as Sudharsan looked to sway away and upper cut, but missed
Gill hints to walk down the pitch, before Thakur goes on a short length on off. It is pushed to mid-off with a closed face of the bat, and a direct hit from Pooran may have had it tight for Gill
shorter side of a length, and angling into a sixth-stump line. But it moves away after pitching, and is tapped towards extra cover
fuller ball, and floated on middle and off. Sudharsan leans forward to flick, but gets a leading edge to mid-off for a hurried single
angling across, and pitching on a good length on off. Dabbed back to Thakur's left
slapped between point and cover point! Thakur bowls it the shorter side of a length, and around sixth stump. The ball shapes to straighten, after which Sudharsan finds the gap for four
And that's finished off in style! Not Sai Kishore's day, and Badoni slogs him high and handsome over midwicket as LSG make it a hat-trick of wins!
Swept square for four! And scores are level! This is on a length and he got down early and nailed the shot!
On a length around off, Samad tucks it behind square on the leg side. Gets a single
On a length outside off, punched down to long-on
Darted full outside off, Samad looks to drive it on the off side and is beaten on the outside edge!
Washington cleans up the left-hander! Miller attempts a sweep but misses and loses his off stump!
Eased through cover for a single
Clipped to long-on for a single
Cramps him with a length ball, Miller looks to cut and chops it onto the ground
Tossed up full around off, Miller sweeps it out to deep backward square
Tossed up outside off, driven out on the off side for a single
Tucked through midwicket for a brace
Swept over short fine! Badoni needed a boundary and he gets it. On a length on the stumps, Badoni gets low and sweeps it just wide of the short fine fielder
Wrong'un on a length outside off, doesn't spin in too much. Badoni cuts to backward point
Tossed full outside off, Miller hits it down the ground to long-on
On a length outside off and angling in, Miller goes back and punches it out to deep cover
Full around off, Badoni skips out and works this to long-on
Washington angles in full ball to pitch just outside off, Miller has a swing and gets an inside edge onto his pad and it deflects towards short third. They get a quick run without much fuss this time

On a length and Miller goes back to pull this along the ground to deep square leg. Run out chance? Siraj thinks it's out. They are celebrating. Miller had to dive as Buttler took the bails off. Uh oh! Buttler takes the bails off before Miller makes his ground, but the ball had left his glove by then! Not a great day for Jos Buttler! Miller survives!
Pushed into the vacant mid-on region for a single. This was full outside off, and Badoni is happy to play it in the gap
On a length outside off, cut to backward point
On a length outside off, Miller blocks it back to Rashid
Floated full on middle, Miller defends
On a length outside off, Badoni steers it through point for a single
On a length and going across Miller with the angle, Miller cuts it away to deep point

Pooran picks out long-on! Rashid continues to win the battle against Pooran, even though he did take a few hits. The two have a bit of friendly banter as Pooran walks off. Length ball angled across him, Pooran goes for a big hit down the ground but doesn't hit this as well as he usually does. Shahrukh Khan makes no mistake
Dropped! Oh my, GT's fielding hasn't been great today and that's the fifth drop today by my count. Badoni goes for a slog sweep and top edges it. Washington puts down a sitter!
Full around leg, Pooran taps it to his left but they don't risk a single
And there he goes again! That's in the slot outside leg and he gets down on one knee and slogs this over square leg! Brutal display again from Nicky P
On a length on middle and spinning away, Pooran cuts to backward point
On a length outside off and angling in, he cuts it away square on the off side
Big shout for lbw as Badoni misses a sweep. The ball rolls through square leg and they take a run. They decide not to review and replays show Badoni got glove on it
On a length around middle, Pooran goes to pull, but gets it off the bottom edge towards short fine
Short outside off, Pooran pulls it out to deep midwicket
Full around off, Pooran defends
Length ball slides down leg. Buttler can't collect cleanly so they get an extra run as well. Badoni had moved across a little, but the umpire still reckons it's a wide
Short ball angled in from around the wicket, Pooran pulls it away to deep midwicket
Short outside off, Badoni doesn't hit it cleanly but manages to pull it out to long-on on the bounce
Full just outside off, driven out to mid-off
Squeezed out through point for a single
Full outside off, Badoni goes inside out over cover and picks up a brace to sweeper cover. The required rate is below six
Yorker around middle, Pooran looks to whip it leg side and ends up inside edging it onto his pads. The ball rolls to his left and they hurry for a single
And now Pooran goes on the off side! Offcutter dug in short and going across. Pooran is able to slap it away over point and he brings up yet another half-century! Different gravy, this guy!
Full around the stumps, Badoni clips it down to long-on
Yorker around off, Pooran is able to squeeze it out towards point

Massive! That's absolutely thwacked over deep midwicket Dug into the pitch around leg and going across Pooran, who stands still and swings it away. Pooran goes back above Sai Sudharsan in the Orange Cap race!
Back of length outside off, Badoni looks for the uppercut, but is beaten by the pace and bounce
Full around off, Badoni clips it to midwicket
Shortish and Pooran pulls it out to deep backward square

Oh, that's a good ball! Pooran is completely deceived by this slower ball on a length on leg that also seams away. Brushed the pad on the way through, that cutter, and Prasidh politely appeals for lbw. No one else interested in that
Length ball outside off, steered to deep third

Markram falls almost exactly like how Shubman Gill got out! And it's Gill who grabs it at long-off! Slower ball on a length outside off, Markram looks to go down the ground. Gets it off the toe end of the bat. Gill settles under it and it's safe hands from the skipper! Falls for 58 off 31, a fine knock comes to an end
Short ball on the stumps, not enough room for Pooran to free his arms. He scuppers as pull to mid-on
Slower ball on a length around middle and off, going in with the angle. Markram works it down to long-on
Full on leg and Markram tucks it through square leg and they take two with ease
Hammered over mid-off! This is short outside off and Markram waits on it and flat-bats it down the ground!
Back of length ball angled across, Pooran shapes to ramp, ends up miscuing it to the keeper's left and to deep third
On a length outside off, steered out to deep point
bam! Deeper and bigger! That is 24 runs off the over! Sai went full and straightish this time, but Pooran is prepared. He gets his front leg out of the way, and blasts it down the ground
but why will the angles ever matter if Pooran is in that kind of a touch?! Sai bowls short yet again, and although this arrives around off, Pooran swings for a big six over midwicket
quicker, and angled into middle and leg. Clipped from deep in the crease to play behind square, raise his fifty
over the umpire's head! Angled in, and full and slow outside off. Markram lofts it late, and times it well to go down the ground
just short of Shahrukh rushing forward from long-on! Short in length again, and this time Pooran can only mistime his attempted swat-pull

slammed over midwicket! That lands 19 rows back! Short in length from Sai, who bowls it around off, but gets it to turn away. Pooran has enough time to read the length and the movement, and pulls hard for six
on a length, and around off. This turns away, and is jabbed towards cover for a quick single
quicker, and on a length. Pushed back defensively
boom! Another six down the ground for Pooran! Washington tossed it up, but got it to dip on the ideal length around off for Pooran to free his arms
on a length on the stumps, and punched back by Pooran
fuller ball on middle and off, and pushed to long-on
a late cut, and four! The ball angled across, and pitched on a length around off. Markram went back, and found the gap between short third and point
full and slower, and on middle. Pushed to long-on, and they push for two again

dropped by Rashid! But another tough chance, given Pooran had absolutely smashed it back. Rashid stuck his left hand up, and the ball tickled the fingers on its way to long-on. He bowled full and around off, as Pooran looked to launch it back and ended up playing aerially
On a length around middle and off, and turning away. A mistimed pull back towards Rashid
bang! Six down the ground! Tossed up from Rashid, who bowled full and straight, and got it to dip. Pooran got his front leg out of the way, and sent that blazing
the googly! This pitches on a fullish length on middle, and turns away, before Pooran blocks it down
quite full, and just outside off. Markram drives it back, and the ball ricochets off Rashid's right boot to end up at long-on. The batters eventually get the single
good pace and bounce for Prasidh! He bowls short on middle and leg, and Pooran looks to hook but is beaten. That one landed at 140kph, and went over Pooran's bat
short of a length on middle and off, and clipped to deep midwicket
mistimed pull from Pooran! On a hard length on middle at 143kph, and there seemed to be too much pace for Pooran there. The ball went aerially towards mid-on
a short delivery on a tight line, as it pitches on leg and ends on middle. Pooran is cramped for room, and he taps it down on the pitch

taken at deep third! LSG and Pant finally run out of their luck! Pant had started looking good, but, as is his style, he keeps going for the big hits. Washington, at deep third, was placed straighter than usual, and kept his eyes on the ball nicely. Prasidh, meanwhile, again bowled it short at Pant. But this time, the LSG captain decided to make room and step out to launch him over the off side. The ball, though, finished around off, and took off from the top edge

swung away to deep square leg! Pant has started hitting them well now. Short in length from Prasidh, who bowled this on middle and off. It was a slower ball, and it finished around off, but Pant read it and pulled powerfully for four
this is quicker from Rashid, and it skids through after pitching on a length on off. Punched to cover point to pinch a single
slog swept to deep square leg! Pant collapsed his back knee, and drilled this full and dipping ball on middle for four. He spotted the gap, and attacked Rashid
very full - nearly a yorker - on middle, and Pant gets an inside edge to short fine leg as he looks to heave
on a fullish length on the stumps, and turning in. Pushed to deep midwicket
cut away through cover point! Another short delivery from Rashid, and although this one didn't have Markram all that room, he still shifted his weight back and found the time to slap it away
short in length on middle and leg, and pulled hard to fine leg
he starts with a full ball outside leg. Pant looks to flick but misses, and it is called wide

a mistimed heave from Markram, as the ball rolls to midwicket. Prasidh went fullish this time, and took pace off while bowling just outside off. Markram collapsed his back knee to try and slog, but seemed to be beaten by the lack of pace
short of a length on leg, and pulled to fine leg

dropped by Sudharsan! But this is a difficult chance at cover! Sudharsan dived to his left and got a hand, but the ball didn't stick. Short in length from Prashidh, who went outside off, before Markram slashed forcefully at it

dropped by Arshad! All the luck going Lucknow's way! Arshad was at short third, and the ball arrived to his right. He stretched his hand out, and the ball dropped off and went for four. That happened after Markram ramped a slower ball which jumped at him after pitching short
extra bounce for Prasidh too! Buttler has to leap to collect this, after Markram shaped to swat but let it go. Short around middle and leg, and this took after pitching
wow, whipped over midwicket! Markram makes room, and Prasidh follows, but in vain! He goes through the line of this short-of-a-length ball arriving just outside off, and dumps it deep into the stands
fullish length, and angling in to arrive on middle and off. Driven back to Arshad

over short third! Almost a mirror image of the boundary Markram got earlier in the over. Shorter of a length, and wide-ish of off. There's some extra bounce for Arshad, and Pant slashes hard off the top half of the bat
short in length again, but this is on middle. Pulled to midwicket for a quick single
flashed off the top half of the bat! On the shorter side of a length on the stumps, and Markram goes slashing at it pretty late. The pace on the ball helps it fly over point
short delivery around middle this time, and swat-pulled on the bounce to midwicket
shortish in length, and angling across to pitch on middle and off. Slashed towards extra cover

Fullish ball on leg, and Pant looked to clip. There was a noise as the ball passed the bat, and Buttler couldn't collect it cleanly. Ohh, Pant had got an inside edge, as confirmed by replays. So Buttler, technically, dropped a catch!

Buttler tumbles to his right, but misses! Typical Pant, who decides to take some risk early. He gets across, and scoops this short-of-a-length ball pitching around off and finishing outside off. He got it off the inside edge, and just beat Buttler

bonus runs for LSG! Siraj went for a bouncer, and both Pant and Buttler may have needed a ladder to reach that!! Short on leg, and Pant shaped to pull before realising the ball took off after pitching. No attempt from Buttler to even leap
fuller ball, and on middle and off. Pushed down to long-on

driven hard, and down the ground! Shorter side of a length around middle and off, as Siraj angled that in. Again the ball ended up on leg after seaming in, before Markram presented the full face of the bat to play between the bowler and mid-off

bottom edge, but wide of the stumps! In fact, the ball goes a long way back towards where a fine-leg fielder would have been. Markram went flashing at this length ball just outside off, but seemed to have played early. Or, maybe, the pitch has really slowed down
chipped wide of mid-on! Siraj bowled on a length on the stumps, and Markram got his front leg out of the way to push forward at this ball, which finished on leg after seaming in
very full, and around sixth stump. Dragged to mid-on with a closed face of the bat
on a short of a length, and in the corridor outside off. Punched towards the man at short third
struck on the knee, but that is heading down the leg side! On a short of a length from Arshad on off, and seaming in to hit Pant on leg, as he looked to clip
full delivery swinging away to arrive around off. Nudged back by Pant

direct hit from mid-on at the striker's end, and GT appeal for run-out half-heartedly! It was a near yorker-length ball from Arshad, who angled it across and went on off. Markram pushed it towards Gill and took off, even as Pant entered the crease on time
bowls this on a short of a length on off, and Pant shifts his weight back to clip behind square

driven between short extra cover and cover point! Siraj bowls on the fuller side, and on off stump or thereabouts. Markram is deep in the crease, and seemingly standing on middle stump, but still leans and drives it in the gap for four
fuller length still, and angling in to pitch on middle and off. Driven to mid-off this time
fullish ball swinging in nicely, and landing on off. It straightens after pitching, and is pushed aerially towards extra cover
short of a length on his hips, and he clips it to the left of the man at square leg
beaten first ball! Siraj angles this across from over the wicket, and bowls on a fullish length while going wide of off. Pant looks to waft away from his body, but misses
on a short of a length on the stumps, as Siraj bowls from close to the stumps. Clipped to deep-backward square leg
